_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate and unfinished two-sided factors keep the honest call as HOLD inside the Denial neighborhood; no breaker is visible.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Denial; analyst explicitly HOLD medium, narrative passive/measured with no opposing directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: Score stays 32-46 and BTC holds range with momentum near 50 through next 12h windows without ETF/stablecoin revival
next_move.invalidated_if: Score exits Denial neighborhood (below 32 or above 46) on a >2.3% trend day, or ETF flows and fed liquidity snap higher with range break
